examples.explanation: A linear phane uses the node-count term and phane without a structure-type prefix.
A monocyclic seven-node simplified skeleton uses cyclo plus hepta plus phane.
The von Baeyer descriptor precedes the node-count term and phane.
The spiro descriptor precedes the node-count term and phane.
